📖 How to use

  1. Upload your PDF.
  2. See the page count instantly.
  3. Check file size, page dimensions and PDF version.
  4. Drop another file to count again.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the page count accurate?

The count comes straight from the PDF's own page tree, so it matches what your PDF reader shows.

Does it detect encrypted PDFs?

Yes — it reports whether the file is encrypted, which is why some PDFs cannot be opened elsewhere.

What are the page dimensions shown?

Width × height in points (72 points = 1 inch) for each page size found.

Is my PDF uploaded?

No — the file is only read locally in your browser.
